name: Pizzeria Gusto Piano
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Gusto Piano in Kufstein**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Gusto Piano** in the charming town of **Kufstein**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the cozy atmosphere of the **Tirol**. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a fresh **Caprese**, our handmade pizzas are baked to perfection in a traditional wood-fired oven.

Indulge in our delicious **Antipasti**—think crispy **Arancini**, creamy **Bruschetta**, and zesty **Focaccia**—before diving into our mouthwatering pasta dishes like **Spaghetti alla Bolognese** or **Tagliatelle al Ragù**.

For dessert, treat yourself to a slice of **Tiramisu**, a scoop of **Gelato**, or a warm **Cannoli**. And don’t forget to pair your meal with one of our fine Italian wines or a refreshing **Aperol Spritz**.

**Gusto Piano** is the perfect spot for a relaxed lunch, a romantic dinner, or a casual get-together with friends. Located in the heart of **Kufstein**, just a short walk from the stunning **Inn River** and the historic **Kufstein Fortress**, it’s an ideal stop for travelers exploring the beauty of **Tirol**.

Come taste the passion behind every dish—**Gusto Piano** awaits!
